title: Samurai Rabbit vs Demons
description: A white rabbit samurai in ornate orange and blue armor stands ready with a katana in a ruined stone courtyard. To the left a red-jacketed man runs from a glowing blue horned demon emerging from a glowing green portal, while on the right an older man in dark clothing faces a giant glowing blue evil rabbit with sharp teeth perched on a twisted tree.
prompt: A dramatic dark fantasy scene set in a ruined stone courtyard at night. A white rabbit samurai wearing detailed orange and blue armor stands in the center holding a katana. To the left, a terrified man in a red tracksuit runs from a glowing blue horned demon emerging from a green misty portal inside an ancient stone archway. On the right, a giant evil blue rabbit with glowing white eyes and sharp teeth grins from a gnarled black tree with orange leaves. Scattered playing cards and candy wrappers litter the cracked ground. Halloween atmosphere with floating leaves and eerie green lighting.
